shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work and hauling, linked weather, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics (documented deviations: floor removal only drops on exposed air; bomb rooftop holes deferred).
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches; HarmonyBoot per-class patching; fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (end of T3)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps (ground comp = column controller + stair registry); stairs pairs generate levels; use-stairs job with shared StairTransfer (carried things ride along, guarded recovery); PageUp/PageDown level view.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass, ledge ring, two lit unroofed face rows, fogged thick-roofed core, guaranteed fog reveal on mining.
- See-below renderer: content-only section copies at y=-2.5, air-cells light mask, live dynamic things below, far clip 70.
- Weather link: sky adopts ground weather every 150 ticks.
- Live sync (MapEvents): roof below governs rooftop above; sky floors write roofs below; things over air fall.
- Cross-level work: virtual scan at the stairwell exit (shared ABVirtualPosition helper; emergency think instance skipped; per-pawn cooldown); idle return to surface; drafted go up/down gizmos; colony-wide Work/Schedule tables.
- Cross-level hauling (T3): WorkGiverDef AB_HaulAcrossLevels (priorityInType 10, after vanilla hauling): items whose better-priority storage lives on a linked level get carried through the stairs by JobDriver_HaulAcrossLevels (reserve, pickup, climb, transfer); vanilla's carried-thing handling finishes storage on arrival. Better-storage decision made by vanilla StoreUtility while the pawn is virtually at the stairwell exit; strictly-greater priority rule prevents level ping-pong; per-item verdict cache (600 ticks, shared across pawns). Settings toggle.
- Cross-level needs (T3): tired colonists whose owned bed is on a directly linked level take the stairs instead of ground-sleeping (JobGiver_GetRest postfix; real bed jobs untouched). Hunger and recreation resolve via idle-return drift. Settings toggle.
- One-colony resources (T3): every column map's ResourceCounter also counts the other levels' stored resources, so the readout and per-map alerts (low food) treat the column as one colony.

## Quadruple pass log
T3: strictly-greater storage priority verified in vanilla source (no equal-priority churn); virtual check contained per validator call; transfer recovery carries cargo; stale verdicts self-heal at job issue. Confidence: hauling 84%, rest redirect 88%, resource counts 90%, refactors 95%.
Known gaps: bills do not actively fetch ingredients across levels (route via stockpiles near benches); patient/medical bed jobs same-level; two-hop bed redirect falls back to ground sleep; Schedule's ghouls current-map only.

## Tranche plan
- T0, T1, T2 DONE (signed off). T3 CODE DONE (awaiting test).
- T4: systems: temperature sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling; renderer polish backlog; publishing prep (field manual, BBCode description, clean folder per global rules).

## Status
T3 compiled green, pushed. Pending test: stockpile-driven hauling between levels, bed redirect, colony-wide resource readout.
